statement: He shows one build that reached about wave 70; there are many other ways to place towers.

creator: nocturne
statement: Click the Totem and select Summon to start waves; the portal comes from the left.

creator: nocturne
statement: Initial setup: Fireball Tower below the rope then Frost Tower; Pulse Mage next; then Fireball; Frost; and a last Fireball.

creator: nocturne
statement: The initial tower setup should get you easily through about wave 10.

creator: nocturne
statement: After wave 10 with enough points summon Kraken Defense Tower then a Party Tower at the top beside the rope.

creator: nocturne
statement: Level new Party Towers to level 5 as quickly as possible since that is when you get benefits.

creator: nocturne
statement: Party Tower level 5 gives a 25% speed bonus.

creator: nocturne
statement: Then wait on points to summon more Party Defense Towers.

creator: nocturne
statement: Keep mobs in check with your abilities by rooting them or attacking yourself.

creator: nocturne
statement: Using root and attacks yourself helps get through early waves a lot faster.

creator: nocturne
statement: Fireball Towers are primary damage dealers; upgrade them to level 5.

creator: nocturne
statement: First Fireball upgrade is Trait B for Explosion Radius.

creator: nocturne
statement: At level 10 select Trait A for chance of 2 Fireballs.

creator: nocturne
statement: Level Frozone Towers to about 5 and always select Trait B.

creator: nocturne
statement: Never select Trait A on Frozone Towers as it is not worth it.

creator: nocturne
statement: Level Pulse Mage Towers to 5 and always select Push Back Non Gigao Enemies.

creator: nocturne
statement: Pushing back enemies helps the Kraken Tower keep enemies in line.

creator: nocturne
statement: Fireball Frost and Pulse Mage are the three towers to primarily select upgrades for.

creator: nocturne
statement: Kraken Cosplayer tower is the least upgrade priority.

creator: nocturne
statement: Select Underlings Push Mobs Back 25% Farther on the Kraken tower to keep them under the Fireball Towers.

creator: nocturne
statement: Otherwise upgrade the towers as much as possible.

creator: nocturne
statement: Upgrade Party Starter Towers in increments of 5; upgrades do nothing until the level 10 benefit so do not waste points unless you can reach it.

creator: nocturne
statement: Later waves are overwhelming due to mob healing and massive health.

creator: nocturne
statement: Keep upgrading Fireball Towers and Party Towers as you need a ton of damage and attack speed.

creator: nocturne
statement: Keep using roots and knockbacks as often as possible to keep mobs in range of the towers.

creator: nocturne
statement: At late stages it is mostly about upgrading towers in the Construction Workbench for more damage and lower upgrade cost.
